voice.name: Hank Harvey - Gruff, Rugged and Wise
voice.why: Josselin Vidal's own voice (Hank Harvey) for what the bar hears: shop and road tips, and the crime rumors only bar staff give to a regular they know.

bar_carlot.text: The car lot in town sells beaters cheap. Check the tires before you sign anything.

bar_fuel.text: There is a fuel stop out on the road. If you run dry past the farms, that is your only hope.

bar_hardware.text: The hardware store has tools. A man with a pick works faster than a man without one.

bar_taxi.text: The taxi stand by the square. Drivers hear everything, but they only tell what pays.

bar_still.text: The old barn off the road is not empty at night. Lights, a truck with no plates, a smell like sour mash. I pour what I pour and keep quiet.

bar_chop.text: Cars go into the yard on the hill and parts come out. You can hear the saws from the road. That is all I know, and all I want to.

bar_fence.text: A man buys odd goods behind a barn on the edge of town. Everybody sees who walks out there. Nobody says why.
